limits: not a real coding-continuation benchmark or automatic skill-discovery test
baseline has one run per direction; full-profile bundle has three forward and two reverse runs; its last reverse run failed strict JSON formatting and stopped that batch
the failed strict run is retained; optional fence removal is a separately labeled factual diagnostic, not a strict pass
first full-profile forward run precedes the final zero-progress paging guard; per-run binary hashes identify this difference

Claude input accounting adds input, cache-creation and cache-read counters; Codex input already includes cached input; counters are not directly comparable between harnesses or equivalent to billed cost
raw logs remain in ignored .artifacts; no personal conversation histories used
